job.title: AI & Automation Consultant @ iDOCTA (Waregem, VLG, BE)
job.description:
### **Wat ga je doen?**

Bij iDocta trekken we volop de kaart van AI. Niet omdat het hip is, maar omdat we geloven dat AI bedrijven fundamenteel slimmer kan laten werken. Van onze eigen organisatie tot de print- en IT-wereld en de dagelijkse werking van onze klanten. Minder manueel werk, slimmere processen en technologie die écht het verschil maakt.

We hebben de ambitie, de ideeën én een stevige lijst aan concrete businesscases. Wat we nog missen? **Iemand die er werk van maakt!**

Jouw eerste testcase? iDocta zelf. Je krijgt de vrijheid om AI te integreren in onze dagelijkse werking. En daarna? Dan trek je met jouw expertise naar onze klanten, vanuit Entrypoint, onze eigen IT-firma.

Een gloednieuwe functie waarin we rotsvast geloven. **We willen gas geven, maar vooral ook iets bouwen dat écht werkt.**

* **Copilot is jouw speeltuin.** Je tilt ons gebruik van Microsoft Copilot naar een hoger niveau.
* **Laat onze systemen praten.** Je verbindt AI met ons ERP, CRM en andere bedrijfsapplicaties.
* **Van idee naar automatisering.** Je zet concrete businesscases om in slimme workflows en AI-agents.
* **Zie kansen waar anderen ze missen.** Je analyseert bedrijfsprocessen en ontdekt waar AI écht het verschil kan maken.
* **Eerst iDocta, daarna onze klanten.** Vanuit Entrypoint adviseer je klanten, bouw je AI-oplossingen en geef je opleidingen om hen helemaal mee te krijgen in het AI-verhaal.

### **Wie ben jij?**

* **Een doener met AI-feeling.** Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met technologie en AI. Een IT-diploma is mooi meegenomen, maar wat je écht kunt, vinden we belangrijker.
* **Technisch helemaal mee.** Copilot Studio, Power Automate, API's en integraties? Daar weet jij raad mee.
* **Een slimme procesdenker.** Je begrijpt hoe bedrijven werken en ziet waar technologie het verschil maakt.
* **Zelfstandig en ondernemend.** Je neemt initiatief, stelt prioriteiten en houdt ook veiligheid en kwaliteit in het oog.
* **Technisch sterk én communicatief.** Je legt complexe zaken helder uit, geeft graag opleidingen en voelt je thuis in een adviserende rol bij klanten.

### **Wat krijg je van ons?**

* **Je loon.** Een marktconform brutoloon, maaltijdcheques van € 6 per gewerkte dag, een DKV-hospitalisatieverzekering én leuke kortingen via Benefits at Work.
* **Je mobiliteit.** Een salariswagen die je brengt waar je moet zijn. Liever op twee wielen? Ook fietslease behoort tot de mogelijkheden!
* **Je vrije tijd.** 26 verlofdagen om de batterijen weer helemaal op te laden.
* **Je groei.** Een gloednieuwe functie, bakken verantwoordelijkheid en een omgeving die vooruit wil. Geen eindeloos overleg, maar ideeën omzetten in actie. Yihaaa!
* **Je collega's.** Hard werken? Absoluut. Maar ook tijd voor plezier, met een wekelijkse teamlunch, afterworks en collega's die graag samen de bloemetjes buitenzetten.

**Freelance of vast? Jij mag mee kiezen!**

Van een freelanceopdracht van één dag per week tot een voltijdse job in loondienst: we staan voor beide open! We willen snel schakelen, maar op lange termijn halen we deze expertise het liefst vast in huis.

job.description:

Chez **Biosynex**, nous lançons un projet stratégique : digitaliser l'ensemble de notre relation client autour d'un CRM Salesforce, d'un catalogue digital et de deux sites e-commerce, l'un BtoB, l'autre BtoC. Le projet est porté par un directeur de projet métier. Nous cherchons son binôme technique : la personne qui conçoit, met en place et fait évoluer l'ensemble des solutions.

**Qui sommes-nous ?**

Créé en 2005 et basé à Illkirch-Graffenstaden en Alsace, Biosynex est un laboratoire français spécialiste du diagnostic rapide, coté sur Euronext Growth Paris. Ses autotests et produits de santé familiale sont vendus dans un large réseau de pharmacies et parapharmacies, tandis que ses solutions de diagnostic équipent laboratoires, hôpitaux, médecins et EHPAD. Avec plus de 450 collaborateurs, une présence dans 95 pays et 101 M€ de chiffre d'affaires en 2024, le groupe poursuit son développement en France et à l'international.

* **Concevoir l'architecture** de l'écosystème relation client : CRM, catalogue, sites BtoB et BtoC, et leurs flux avec les outils existants (ERP, logistique, paiement).
* **Paramétrer et faire évoluer Salesforce** : modèle de données, automatisations, droits, parcours clients, en lien avec l'intégrateur.
* **Mettre en place les sites e-commerce** sur Shopify ou une solution équivalente : choix techniques, configuration, applications, gestion des spécificités BtoB (tarifs clients, comptes professionnels, commandes en volume).
* **Structurer le catalogue digital** : modèle de données produits, alimentation, synchronisation entre CRM, catalogue et sites.
* **Piloter les intégrations SaaS** : API, connecteurs, flux de données, supervision et gestion des incidents.
* **Garantir la qualité technique** : recette, sécurité, conformité RGPD, performance, documentation.
* **Être le référent technique** du directeur de projet métier, des porteurs de projet et des prestataires : traduire les besoins métier en solutions concrètes et éclairer les arbitrages.

**Votre profil**

Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience technique sur des projets CRM ou e-commerce.

**Compétences techniques**

* Très bonne maîtrise de **Salesforce** : paramétrage avancé, automatisations, modèle de données (une certification Administrateur ou Consultant est un plus).
* Expérience concrète de **Shopify** ou d'une plateforme e-commerce équivalente, idéalement en BtoB et BtoC.
* Solide connaissance des **solutions SaaS** et de leurs intégrations : API REST, webhooks, connecteurs, outils d'intégration.
* Bonne compréhension des données produits et clients (catalogue, PIM, qualité de données).
* Maitrise de l’IA

**Compétences métier**

* **Retail** : vous connaissez les enjeux du commerce de détail (parcours omnicanal, offre produits, clients professionnels et particuliers).
* **Pilotage technique** : vous savez organiser les travaux techniques, suivre les intégrateurs et tenir vos engagements dans le cadre du projet.

**Savoir-être**

* **Rigoureux·se** : vous travaillez avec méthode et souci du détail.
* **Communicant·e** : vous savez expliquer des sujets techniques simplement.
* **Curieux·se** : vous suivez les nouveautés du digital et du retail et aimez proposer des idées.
* **Proche du terrain** : vous aimez travailler au quotidien, en proximité directe avec les porteurs de projet métier.

**Ce que nous offrons**

* CDI, statut cadre.
* Avantages : télétravail, tickets restaurant, mutuelle, etc.
* Un rôle clé dans un projet structurant, avec une vraie autonomie technique.

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to develop your marketing skills while also helping to create a well-organized and welcoming office environment?

We are looking for a **Marketing Specialist & Coordinator** to join our Nordics & Netherlands department.

Our department operates across two markets: the Nordics and the Netherlands. This position will be based with our local team in Haarlem. As we continue to grow, we are also exploring the possibility of relocating our office closer to Amsterdam in the future.

The role combines marketing coordination (approximately 80%) with office management (approximately 20%).

You will play an important role in coordinating and executing marketing and sales activities, primarily in the Netherlands, while also helping to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of our office.

If you enjoy coordinating projects, creating structure, collaborating with different stakeholders and taking ownership of getting things done, we would love to hear from you.

**About the role**

As our **Marketing Specialist & Coordinator**, you will play a key operational role in supporting marketing and sales activities in the Netherlands.

The majority of your time will be dedicated to **marketing tasks**, including events, webinars, marketing materials, localization of materials and equipment logistics. Alongside this, you will take responsibility for selected **office management and administrative activities**, helping create an efficient, professional and welcoming working environment.

This is a hands-on position where structure, coordination, service-mindedness and execution are essential.

**Your responsibilities**

**Marketing Coordination – approximately 80%**

* Localize global marketing assets for the Dutch market, including translation and market adaptation.
* Create and adapt marketing materials for social media, email campaigns, events and printed materials using available tools.
* Plan, coordinate and execute local events from start to finish.
* Ensure seamless event delivery, including venue and catering coordination, participant materials, equipment setup, on-site support and post-event follow-up.
* Coordinate and execute webinars and other marketing activities.
* Manage demo equipment logistics, including inventory control, shipments to resellers and partners, and availability of demo equipment and event merchandise.
* Contribute to selected marketing projects and initiatives led by the Head of Marketing & Academy.

**Office Management – approximately 20%**

* Coordinate the daily office routine and help ensure the office is organized, welcoming and running smoothly.
* Act as a point of contact for general office-related enquiries and coordinate requests with the relevant colleagues.
* Manage office supplies, orders and inventory and liaise with external suppliers and service providers when needed.
* Support the organization of internal meetings and events, including meeting rooms, catering and practical arrangements.
* Provide general administrative and coordination support to the Regional Director in relation to the Netherlands office, including meeting preparation, travel arrangements, documentation and follow-up on operational matters.

**Your skills**

We imagine you have an academic or vocational background in **marketing, business administration, commercial studies or a related field**, potentially combined with relevant professional experience in marketing coordination, commercial support, office management or a similar role.

* You are structured, detail-oriented and proactive, with a strong hands-on attitude.
* You enjoy taking ownership of tasks and driving them through to completion.
* You are comfortable balancing different responsibilities and priorities in a dynamic environment.
* You have excellent organizational skills and can work independently while knowing when to involve others.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, suppliers and international stakeholders.
* You are fluent in **Dutch and English**, both written and spoken.
* Solid Microsoft Office skills are required, and experience with marketing, CRM or design tools such as Figma and email marketing platforms is an advantage.

**What we offer**

For the motivated candidate with the right willingness to engage, we offer a varied role where you can gain broad experience while making a visible contribution to our business in the Netherlands.

You will have the opportunity to take ownership of day-to-day marketing activities, contribute to larger projects with an international reach and play an important role in creating a well-functioning local office.

We value people who show initiative, bring new ideas to the table and are motivated by making a positive difference.

Further, we offer:

* The opportunity to work closely with experienced professionals and gain insights into the MedTech industry.
* An international working environment with collaboration across markets and functions.
* Opportunities for professional development and expansion of your responsibilities.

**Start date:** As soon as possible

We **welcome applications from all backgrounds** and are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse working environment.

**If you are an organized, proactive and service-minded person who enjoys marketing and thrives on making things happen, we would be excited to hear from you!**

Please contact the hiring manager, Sunniva Nekså, Head of Marketing & Academy at Sunniva.melandsoe@3shape.com.

**About 3Shape:**

To learn more about 3Shape, visit our Instagram here and our webpage here. You can also have a peek into our social profile here.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About us**

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. * Je monitort campagneprestaties, analyseert resultaten en identificeert optimalisatiemogelijkheden om de effectiviteit van campagnes continu te verbeteren.

**OVER JOU**

* Je hebt 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring binnen CRM, digital marketing, e-commerce, campagne management of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.
* Je hebt ervaring met het plannen, coördineren en uitvoeren van marketing- of CRM-campagnes.

Ardo is an internationally growing family-owned company with expertise in frozen vegetables, herbs, and fruit. Our greatest strength? Our people. Every day, our colleagues bring passion, craftsmanship, and an entrepreneurial mindset to help bring the very best of nature to millions of consumers. By managing the entire value chain, from seed selection and cultivation to processing, packaging, distribution, quality, innovation, and flexibility are at the heart of everything we do. This enables us to respond quickly to emerging trends and the evolving needs of our customers.

Sustainability is not an ambition for tomorrow, it is a responsibility we embrace today. We continuously invest in sustainable farming practices, energy-efficient processes, and strong, long-term partnerships with growers, suppliers, and customers. Together, we are building a healthier future for our planet and for generations to come.

Working at Ardo means being part of an international family where collaboration, respect, commitment, and entrepreneurship go hand in hand. It is a place where your talent is valued, where you can grow and develop, and where you help preserve the best of nature every single day.

### **Here’s what you’ll do:**

Are you passionate about improving logistics processes and translating operational needs into smart and sustainable digital solutions? We are looking for a Business Analyst SAP EWM/TM to join our IT team and help shape the future of our Warehousing and Transportation landscape.

In this role, you act as the SAP Warehousing & Transportation Management specialist, taking end-to-end responsibility for the functional scope and architecture within your domain. You will play a key role in the further rollout of SAP S/4HANA, while also contributing to our broader digitalization roadmap for Warehousing and Transportation.

**SAP S/4HANA rollout**

As part of our SAP transformation, you will:

* Work closely with business stakeholders and key users to understand and map end-to-end Warehousing and Transportation processes.
* Gather, challenge and structure business requirements and translate them into effective SAP EWM/TM solutions.
* Identify potential gaps between business requirements and the existing SAP template and define appropriate solutions.
* Further develop and improve the existing deployment template, with a strong focus on standardization, scalability and reusability across our organization.
* Take an active role throughout the full implementation lifecycle, from requirements and solution design through realization and testing to go-live and aftercare.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for SAP EWM/TM, providing functional expertise and guidance within your domain.
* Support our team of SAP functional analysts by sharing knowledge, demonstrating solutions and explaining business processes and system functionality.
* Coordinate EWM/TM-related activities and projects within the broader S/4HANA rollout roadmap.

**Digitalization & continuous improvement**

* Your role goes beyond SAP implementation. Together with the IT Application Manager, you will contribute to the further digitalization of our logistics operations by:
* Mapping existing Warehousing and Transportation processes and identifying opportunities for optimization, automation and digitalization.
* Defining and maintaining the digitalization roadmap for Warehousing and Transportation.
* Translating business challenges and opportunities into clear functional and system requirements.
* Evaluating and selecting the right solutions, technologies and vendors.
* Overseeing the functional design and implementation of new digital solutions.
